Where to Order Thanksgiving Takeout in Austin in 2026

By
Katie Walker
-
Nov 17, 2026
131
Share
Facebook
X
Pinterest
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 6:26
    Instaread

    Thanksgiving is just around the corner, and if you’re planning to skip the cooking this year, Austin restaurants have you covered. From complete holiday meals and smoked meats to individual sides and desserts, here’s where to order Thanksgiving takeout in Austin for an easy holiday at home.

    Where to Order Thanksgiving Takeout in Austin

    Swedish Hill

    Swedish Hill is offering a Thanksgiving menu with whole roasted turkey, herbed pepper gravy, green bean casserole, baked mac and cheese, house-made cranberry sauce, and pies. Guests can order a complete holiday spread or choose items à la carte.

    • Order deadline: Tuesday, November 24
    • Pickup: Wednesday, November 25, from 10 a.m.–1 p.m.
    • Pickup locations:
      • South 1st: 1804 South 1st St.
      • Westlake: Trinity Episcopal School of Austin, 950 Westbank Dr., Austin, TX 78746
    • Order online: Order here

    Rudy’s Bar-B-Q

    Rudy’s Bar-B-Q is offering smoked turkey breast and bone-in spiral glazed ham for Thanksgiving. Guests can also add sides like cream corn, potato salad, coleslaw, three-bean salad, and Rudy’s Beans.

    • Whole turkey breast: 3.5 pounds for $55
    • Bone-in spiral glazed ham: 7 pounds for $70
    • Turkey availability: Local pickup, delivery, and nationwide shipping
    • Ham availability: Local pickup and delivery
    • Preorders: Begin November 1
    • Pickup deadline: Wednesday, November 25
    • Order online: Rudy’s To-Go & Delivery or Rudy’s Anywhere

    All Rudy’s locations will be closed on Thanksgiving Day.

    Aris Mediterranean Steakhouse

    Aris Mediterranean Steakhouse is offering Thanksgiving pre-order packages with half or whole deboned turkeys and a selection of Mediterranean-inspired sides. Additional sides, olive rolls, kebabs, olive oil marmalade, and olive oil cake are available à la carte.

    • Half deboned turkey: $225
    • Whole deboned turkey: $400
    • Sides package: $65

    Terry Black’s Barbecue

    Terry Black’s Barbecue is offering holiday family packs with a selection of meats and freshly made sides. Guests can choose between two sizes, with pickup available the day before Thanksgiving.

    • Large family pack: $288, serves 10–12; includes six pounds of meat and five quarts of sides
    • Small family pack: $144.50, serves 5–6; includes three pounds of meat and five pints of sides
    • Pickup: Wednesday, November 25
    • Order online: Order here

    Galaxy Cafe

    Galaxy Cafe is offering a fully house-made Thanksgiving menu with roasted turkey breast, traditional sides, and seasonal desserts. Items are available à la carte and come fully cooked with reheating instructions.

    • Preorder deadline: Sunday, November 22, at 5 p.m.
    • Pickup: November 24 and 25, from 11 a.m.–8 p.m.
    • Locations: Three locations; select your preferred pickup location when ordering
    • Order online: Galaxy Cafe

    Aba Austin

    Aba is offering a Thanksgiving Dinner for Two To-Go with Mediterranean-inspired dishes, including hummus, Greek village salad, truffle baked orzo, beef tenderloin kebab, turkey breast with gravy, and sticky date cake. Additional mezze, wine, and other items are available to add on.

    • Cost: $119.95, plus tax
    • Order deadline: Monday, November 23, at 4 p.m.
    • Pickup: Wednesday, November 25, from 11 a.m.–4 p.m.
    • Address: 1011 S. Congress Ave., Building 2, Suite 180, Austin, TX 78704
    • Details: Orders are served cold with reheating instructions. Aba will be closed on Thanksgiving Day.
    • Order online: Aba Austin

    Ēma Austin

    Ēma is offering a Thanksgiving Dinner for Two To-Go with a Mediterranean-inspired menu. The meal includes pumpkin hummus, whipped feta, Parmesan farrotto, Greek salad, Brussels sprouts, beef tenderloin kebab, cider and sumac-brined turkey breast, and apple kataifi tarte tatin.

    • Cost: $126.95, plus tax
    • Order deadline: Tuesday, November 24, at 10 a.m.
    • Pickup: Wednesday, November 25, from 11 a.m.–5 p.m.
    • Address: 3120 Palm Way #170, Austin, TX 78758
    • Details: Orders are served cold with reheating instructions. Additional mezze and Ema wine are available to add on. Ēma will be closed on Thanksgiving Day.
    • Order online: Ēma Austin

    The Well

    The Well is offering Thanksgiving takeout with the option to order individual dishes or a full holiday package that feeds six to eight people. Pickup and delivery are available from its Westlake, 2nd Street, and Bouldin locations.

    • Order deadline: Thursday, November 19
    • Pickup and delivery: November 24 and 25
    • Locations: Westlake, 2nd Street, and Bouldin
    • Preorder online: The Well

    Corner Restaurant

    Corner Restaurant is offering Thanksgiving takeout with smoked turkey, classic holiday sides, cornbread, gravy, cranberry sauce, and pumpkin and pecan pies. Guests can choose between two family feast sizes.

    • Family feast for 4–6: $290
    • Family feast for 10–12: $580
    • Order deadline: Monday, November 23
    • Pickup: Wednesday, November 25, through Thanksgiving Day until 11 a.m.
    • Availability: Limited quantities
    • Order online: Corner Restaurant

    Walton’s Fancy & Staple

    Walton’s Fancy & Staple is offering Thanksgiving dishes à la carte, making it easy to order a full holiday meal or add a few items to your own menu. Options include appetizers, turkey breast, sides, pies, and other seasonal desserts.

    • Order deadline: November 24
    • Pickup: November 24–25
    • To order: Call 512-542-3380 or email catering@waltonsfancyandstaple.com
    • Note: Walton’s will be closed on Thanksgiving Day.

    Where to Order Thanksgiving Desserts in Austin

    Gati

    Gati is offering a selection of Thanksgiving desserts, including pumpkin crème brûlée, pumpkin ice cream pie, pumpkin roll with cream cheese filling, pecan pie, apple maple walnut pie, and French silk pie. Guests can also share dietary restrictions when placing an order.

    • Order deadline: 11 p.m. on November 18, or until sold out
    • Pickup: November 23, 24, or 25
    • Order online: Gati
    • Full menu: View the menu

    Hotel Saint Cecilia

    Hotel Saint Cecilia is offering its signature holiday pies for Thanksgiving, with flavors including cherry cobbler, blackbottom pecan, pumpkin, and coconut Chantilly. Bourbon vanilla bean Chantilly or pumpkin spiced Chantilly is also available by the quart.

    • Pies: $40 each
    • Chantilly: $10 per quart
    • Preorder deadline: November 20
    • Pickup: November 23–26, from 9 a.m.–2 p.m.
    • Pickup location: Hotel Saint Cecilia Lounge
    • More information: Hotel Saint Cecilia Holiday Pies

    Easy Tiger

    Easy Tiger is offering Thanksgiving pies for preorder at both of its locations.

    • Preorder window: November 1–20
    • Pickup: November 20–25
    • Locations: Both Easy Tiger locations
    • More information: Easy Tiger Pies

    The Salty

    The Salty is offering a seasonal pie donut box with four flavors inspired by classic Thanksgiving desserts. Each $27 box includes one donut slice of pecan pie, pumpkin pie, apple crumb pie, and chocolate cream pie.

    • Cost: $27 per box
    • Preorder deadline: November 18
    • Pickup: Thursday, November 26, or in-store November 23–26
    • Order online: The Salty
